Lovely glamour set (plain gold-cased red lipstick on a gold-rimmed mirror tray, blush backdrop, the ruby the same red as the bullet), but the model will not draw the huggies at true size against the lipstick. Attempt 1 (better): each huggie about 28mm tall against the 20mm case (true 15mm, about three quarters of the case), with 8-9 stones per hoop against a true 7. Attempt 2 made them about 30mm and wrapped one round the whole case, which is impossible. Suggest a recast with a referent the hoops can sit beside, not on, such as both huggies on the mirror beside the bullet.

jobs.notes: FAIL: huggies about 1.9x (each as tall as the red bullet and wider than the case); 8-9 baguettes running round most of each hoop (true 7 on the lower front half).

Preserve the piece exactly: do not redesign, restyle, resize or add anything. CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A PAIR of small HUGGIE HOOP earrings in warm 18k gold tone, each 15mm across, a smooth round gold tube about 3mm thick, hinged with a snap closure: the lower front half of each hoop carries 1 single row of 7 deep ruby-red rectangular BAGUETTE-cut cubic zirconia standing crosswise, side by side, each held by small gold claws; the upper half and the back of each hoop are plain polished gold. Exactly 2 huggies. SCALE TEST: Each huggie is 15mm across, a 3mm gold tube; the lipstick's plain gold case is about 20mm across and 5cm tall with the red bullet rising about 2cm above it, so each huggie is a little smaller than the width of the case; each ruby baguette is about 3mm by 2mm. concept: Emerald Baguette Tennis Bracelet wrapped round the arched handle of an old brass railway hand-lamp glowing green, standing on a platform bench at dusk.
headline: Green signal.
notes: Reshoot: an old brass hand-lamp with one glowing green lens stands on a weathered platform bench at dusk, the emerald bracelet looped over the top bar of the arched handle and hanging as a narrow loop with its box clasp, a separate piece of jewellery. Construction exact: crosswise bright-emerald baguettes in 4-claw gold box settings, open backs on the far strand, box clasp with safety; about 45 stones; the line reads about 6mm against the handle, so scale is true. Plain deep-blue dusk sky in the top quarter; two warm bokeh at the left. Two small glints on the right strand. The glowing lens sits low (72-86% of the height), so a 4:5 centre crop may clip its lower edge slightly.

jobs.notes: FAIL: the bracelet was laid round the lamp's top rim like a built-in jewelled collar (it read as part of the lamp and about 1.6x too large, not on the handle); a street lamp and bokeh in the top quarter.
